title: 设置弹窗 · 左侧导航对齐（真实 DSH DOM）

assertions.message: 导航行铺满左栏，图标与设置标题左对齐
assertions.expression: (() => { const dialog = document.querySelector('[role="dialog"]'); const nav = dialog?.querySelector(':scope > nav'); const title = dialog?.querySelector(':scope > div:first-child'); const list = nav?.querySelector(':scope > div:last-child'); if (!nav || !title || !list) return false; const textRange = document.createRange(); textRange.selectNodeContents(title); const titleText = textRange.getBoundingClientRect(); if (titleText.width === 0) return false; const near = (a, b) => Math.abs(a - b) <= 1; const listRect = list.getBoundingClientRect(); const rows = [...list.querySelectorAll(':scope > button')]; if (getComputedStyle(list).alignItems !== 'normal' || rows.length !== 5) return false; return rows.every((row) => { const rect = row.getBoundingClientRect(); const icon = row.querySelector('svg')?.getBoundingClientRect(); return near(rect.left, listRect.left) && near(rect.width, listRect.width) && icon !== undefined && near(icon.left, titleText.left); }); })()

assertions.message: 导航行仍保持 DSH 的 40px 高度
键盘聚焦环完整画在导航行内部
assertions.expression: (() => { const dialog = document.querySelector('[role="dialog"]'); const row = dialog?.querySelectorAll('nav button')[1]; if (!row) return false; row.focus({ focusVisible: true }); const style = getComputedStyle(row); return document.activeElement === row && style.outlineStyle === 'solid' && style.outlineWidth === '2px' && style.outlineOffset === '-2px'; })()
